text: City Staff recommendation is to pursue this “middle ground” option as a balanced approach that will see the actual City tax investment for this project to be an estimated $130,000, well below any initial projections. This would double restroom capacity, improve the interior of the concession stand, and enhance the rear picnic shelter area into a three-season space. This maintains historical charm, creates individual and family changing rooms, while also increasing much-needed revenue. Recommended Action: A motion to direct City Staff to proceed with a Neshotah Beach concession stand major renovation project for 2026, in the total project amount not-to-exceed $520,000, with the total City borrowing to support the project not-to-exceed $256,000 and the actual City tax investment not-to-exceed $131,000 after Room Tax contributions
